positions.name: StructuredCalibrationFields
positions.frame: when a narrative claim about calibration is restated as flat label-value fields, what relationship holds between the two forms?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 both drop the connected-prose framing of src-1 into a matter-of-fact, unhedged label-colon-value register (per register and conviction reads), restating the same instrument-and-calibration facts as structured fields rather than narrated claims — a shared directional move from narrative to catalogue that spans exactly these two expressions.
